title: Benchmark registry (benchmarks/<family>.yaml)
description: Key performance indicators of one process family, each with independent reference ranges from cited open sources (or a recorded 'no open reference'), and the datasets they are evaluated on, as expressions over the dataset's exchanges. docs/benchmarks.md explains it.

family.description: Slug of taxonomy/families.yaml; the file is benchmarks/<family>.yaml.

datasets.description: The LCI datasets the indicators are evaluated on.

key.description: An exchange key of an LCI dataset, <kind>:<id>.

kpi.description: One indicator: what it measures, in which unit, and its reference ranges, or why there is none.

unit.description: Unit of the indicator and of every range, as core's foundation.units reads it (e.g. kWh/t, GJ/t).

no_open_reference.description: Why no range is recorded: which open sources were searched, and when. A KPI with this is reported as no-reference, never invented.

reference.description: A range taken as a fact from a cited open source, recorded in our own form in the KPI's unit.

range.description: [low, high] in the KPI's unit, as the source states it (a conversion we made is stated in note).

basis.description: What the value is compared with: unallocated, the whole process's exchange per unit of the named product (as the literature reports specific consumptions).

conditions.description: The conditions the source states the range for. They are not compared by the build: the binding chooses a reference whose conditions match the dataset's, and says where they differ.

locator.description: Page, table or section of the value.

kind.description: bref, iea and peer-reviewed are preferred; manufacturer literature only where no other open source states the conditions, and flagged as such.

binding.description: One dataset and the indicators evaluated on it.

dataset.description: The id of the LCI dataset (lci_dataset id).

conditions.description: The dataset's own conditions, in the reference's terms, for the reader's comparison.

evaluation.description: How one indicator is computed from the dataset, and which reference it is compared with.

expression.description: Exchange keys and numbers with + - * / and brackets, operators between spaces (a key may contain '-'); e.g. 'feed:POWER / product:GOXP'. Units follow the exchanges' units and are converted to the KPI's unit by core.

per.description: The product the indicator is per unit of: the allocated value is the value times this product's allocation share (recorded by build_lci).

reference.description: The id of the KPI's reference to compare with; required when the KPI has references.

out_of_range_reason.description: Why the dataset's value is outside the reference range. Required for an out-of-range value: without it --strict fails; given for a value inside, it is reported as stale.
